column1: # Kaintana Core Smoke Tests — Phase A kernel validation suite
# expect_cmds: exact integer, ">=N", or "-" for non-render tests
# golden: filename or "-" to skip pixel comparison
# NOTE: All render tests MUST set explicit kt_width/kt_height on leaf elements
#       because layout defaults to 0px for unspecified dimensions.

column4: calls
column7: desc

column4: kt_init(); kt_make("test",80,24); kt_begin(s,16.0); kt_row(s,0,"box","root"); kt_fill(s,1,"#FF0000"); kt_width(s,1,80.0); kt_height(s,1,24.0); kt_end_row(s); kt_end(s)
column7: Single 80x24 filled element produces exactly 1 draw command

column4: kt_init(); kt_make("test",80,24); kt_begin(s,16.0); kt_end(s)
column7: Empty frame with no elements produces 0 draw commands
